name: Anthony (United States)
description: Blue field with red and white rays converging from the hoist to a point, and a white star at the fly: the colours of Texas, showing Anthony at the tip of the state.
history: Anthony is an incorporated town in El Paso County, Texas. The flag was adopted in 2018 (announced by the mayor in May 2018, according to Flags of the World).
